#### Pratical advice
* Ideally, do not put the tablet on the ground. If you do, try to do it mindfully as a black tablet can be hard to find in a dark understorey.

* If you have to put the tablet on the ground, place it vertically againt a tree: it is less likely that someone will step on it.

* Tie a fluo ribbon to the tablet: it will be easier to find it if you lose in the forest.

* The tablets we use come with a stylus: if you do not use it, it is better to keep it at the office to avoid its loss in the field.
